label: Flow
notes: Screen, autolaunched, record-triggered, scheduled and platform-event flows; scripts/flow_to_steps.py reads the .flow-meta.xml

label: Process Builder
notes: A Flow with processType Workflow; scripts/flow_to_steps.py reads it like any flow

label: Apex class
notes: The automation-logic-reader agent reads the .cls source; data/automation-elements.csv maps code to cards

label: Apex trigger
notes: The automation-logic-reader agent reads the .trigger source and follows the handler class it calls

label: Workflow rule
notes: Criteria, then field updates, email alerts, tasks and outbound messages, immediate or time-based

label: Assignment rule
notes: Rule entries in order; the first that matches assigns the owner

label: Auto-response rule
notes: Rule entries in order; the first that matches sends its email template

label: Escalation rule
notes: Rule entries with time-based escalation actions

label: Approval process
notes: Entry criteria, approval steps, and the actions on submit, approve, reject and recall

label: Validation rule
notes: One condition and its error message; drawn as a decision and a custom error

label: OmniScript
notes: The OmniScript definition (JSON); steps, set values, data mapper and integration procedure actions

label: Data mapper
notes: Extract, load or transform; usually one card

label: FlexCard
notes: Drawn as one card on the chain level; no logic level

sf_types: Lightning Component|Lightning Component Bundle|Aura Component Bundle|Lightning web component|Aura component bundle
label: Lightning component
notes: Drawn as one card on the chain level; its Apex controller is the automation to trace

label: Platform event
notes: Prefer an entity with an __e API name; kept for models that list the event as an automation

label: Automation
notes: Anything else; the reader explains it in the card's footer
